extract.name: Extract
extract.tip: Step 1 of 3: Choose an MC world and extract road, house, and landmark assets.

preview.name: Preview
preview.tip: Step 2 of 3: Test seeds and Avenue/Street settings before the final build.

build.name: Build
build.tip: Step 3 of 3: Build the city, render it, and export the MC world.

roads.caption: Road pieces
roads.message: Extract assets to scan the selected road sample area and build a road contact sheet.

builds.caption: Building pieces
builds.message: Extract assets to scan the selected house and landmark areas and build a building contact sheet.

grid.caption: Road layout
grid.message: Preview layout to see the road network before building the final city.

cityPreview.caption: City layout
cityPreview.message: Preview layout to see how buildings fit into the generated road network.

cityRender.caption: Final city
cityRender.message: Build city to create the schematic, the render, and the exported MC world.

world.label: MC world
world.sourceTip: The MC version of the world you selected.
world.targetTip: Lets you confirm which MC version you plan to paste into. MC CityGen still stamps the exported files to the source world's version.
world.resetTip: Go back to the sample world that comes with MC CityGen, with its three areas.

road.name: Road area
road.tip: Choose an area that contains the road pieces you want MC CityGen to reuse.

house.name: House area
house.tip: Choose a sample area with your standard houses or smaller buildings.

landmark.name: Landmark area
landmark.tip: Choose a sample area with taller or special buildings that should stand out in the city.

build.worldsTip: Open the folder of exported worlds, to copy one into your MC saves.

extract.ready: Extract road, house, and landmark pieces from the selected areas.
extract.blocked: Choose an MC world and all three areas first.

preview.ready: Generate a fast road and city layout preview.

build.ready: Build the final schematic, render, and export world.

mapDrawing: Drawing your world from above. You can already pan, zoom, and choose your area.
selection: Selection: x {x0} to {x1}, z {z0} to {z1} ({chunksX} x {chunksZ} chunks)

FINE.label: City size
FINE.tip: Changes the footprint of the finished city.

GAP_MIXED.label: Road density
GAP_MIXED.tip: Controls how tightly Avenues and Streets are packed across the city.

PAD_BIG.label: Avenue edge margin
PAD_BIG.tip: Keeps Avenues farther from the edge of the city.

PAD_SMALL.label: Street edge margin
PAD_SMALL.tip: Keeps Streets farther from the edge of the city.

BANNED_BUILDINGS.label: Skip building IDs
BANNED_BUILDINGS.tip: Optional comma-separated building IDs to leave out of generation.

TYPE1_TOP_FIT_CHOICES.label: House style variety
TYPE1_TOP_FIT_CHOICES.tip: Higher values mix in more different standard house designs.

LANDMARK_SPACING.label: Landmark spacing
LANDMARK_SPACING.tip: Minimum fine-cell distance between landmark footprints.

not_a_world.title: Not an MC world

no_world.title: Missing world path
no_world.message: Choose a valid MC world before selecting an area on the map.

areas_missing.title: Invalid extraction region
areas_missing.message: Choose an MC world and all three areas first.

failures.no_road_pieces: Road extraction found no pieces in the road area. Check the area, or that the world has marked road pieces.
failures.no_ground_fill: The road pieces are missing the ground fill, piece 18. Extract again.
